name: Vectidromeus
isnote: Longrich et al. 2024 called it a hypsilophodontid; Fonseca et al. 2024 placed it in Euiguanodontia and possibly Dryosauridae.
sum: A small ornithopod from the Early Cretaceous Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight, known from a juvenile partial skeleton.
wsnote: The holotype is a juvenile, so no adult size is given.
holotype: IWCMS 2023.102, an incomplete juvenile skeleton from near Sudmoor Point, Isle of Wight.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Longrich et al. 2024
